speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallory-Weiss Tear with potential progression to Boerhaave syndrome or Esophageal rupture.

Based on the history of forceful retching after alcohol consumption followed by acute chest pain and a sensation of something stuck, this is highly suggestive of an esophageal injury. Given the severity of symptoms and the inability to swallow, immediate surgical consultation is required.
